name: Mukhyamantri Sampoorna Pushti Yojana: Maternal Nutrition
benefit:
- **Take Home Ration:** Chikki/ladoo(s) and eggs are provided to pregnant women and lactating mothers under Supplementary Nutrition Programme (SNP). Additionally, the following nutrient-rich products would be provided under this scheme in addition to their existing entitlements.
**Sl. No****Type of Take Home Ration****Monthly Quantity**1Til Ladoo500 gram (25 pieces of 20 gram each)2Paushtik Bhel75
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Odisha. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a lactating mother registered and residing within the service area of the concerned Anganwadi Centre (AWC).
